title: Dog Leads Florida Deputy to Missing Elderly Woman
description:
* (Disclaimer: The content in this video is intended for educational and informational purposes only)
Shalimar, Florida — On September 25, 2025, the Okaloosa County Sheriff's Office received a call from a distraught husband concerned about his missing wife. When an 86-year old citizen took a tumble and injured herself while walking her son's dog in the Destin area. Eeyore, the dog she was walking, stayed by her side and ultimately guided a responding deputy straight to her location. Paramedics were summoned, and the woman was taken to a medical facility for evaluation.
